title: Corrigendum to the Amendments to the Rules of Procedure of the General Court (OJ L, 2024/2095, 12.8.2024)
text:
Official Journal of the European Union
EN
L series
2024/90835
23.12.2024
Corrigendum to the Amendments to the Rules of Procedure of the General Court
(
Official Journal of the European Union L, 2024/2095, 12 August 2024
)
On page 22, point 48(c):
for:
‘c)
Paragraph 5 is deleted and replaced by the following text:
“The provisions of Article 110a and Article 219 shall apply only after the entry into force of the decision referred to, respectively, in Article 110a(4) and Article 219(4).”
’,
read:
‘c)
Paragraph 5 is deleted and replaced by the following text:
“The provisions of Article 110a and Article 219 shall apply only after the entry into force of the decision referred to, respectively, in Article 110a(8) and Article 219(8).”
’.
